content.short: Cryptorefills lets users buy gift cards, mobile top-ups, flights and hotels with Bitcoin and crypto.
content.description: Cryptorefills turns crypto into everyday spending: gift cards from major brands, mobile phone top-ups, and flight and hotel bookings paid with Bitcoin, stablecoins and other assets. It runs several mini apps inside World App, including separate Cryptorefills, Flights and Hotels apps, all listed in World's ecosystem directory. Spending directly from a wallet avoids first cashing out to a bank.
content.meta: Cryptorefills sells gift cards, top-ups, flights and hotels for crypto, with mini apps in World App.
